authority_note: Additive review artifact. Scores cover the first six business-quality categories only. Expectation gap/asymmetry, final Hard Veto, total score and company latest promotion remain unresolved until valuation/red-team completion. Unknowns are not converted to zero or PASS.

evidence: Q2 2026 revenue KRW3.4572tn +24% YoY and operating profit KRW440.4bn +107%.
AI-server/network MLCC, high-end FCBGA and automotive demand are broadening; >10 MLCC long-term supply agreements.
counter_evidence: Semiconductor/component cycles and customer concentration remain material; AI-related capacity returns are not yet fully seasoned.

evidence: Q2 2026 revenue KRW8.927tn +20.2% and operating profit KRW1.6451tn +72.5%.
High-value LNG/LPG vessel mix and productivity gains are lifting margins.
counter_evidence: Shipbuilding remains cycle- and FX-sensitive; subsidiary/SOTP and working-capital economics require normalization.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW1.577tn +32.2% and operating profit KRW178.5bn +64.4%.
New orders KRW2.1tn and backlog KRW7tn, with big-tech distribution and extra-high-voltage transformer demand.
counter_evidence: Power-equipment cycle duration and returns on global capacity expansion are not yet fully proven.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW5.44tn +65% and operating profit KRW736.1bn +98%.
High-value vessels and offshore project execution drove a major earnings step-up; H1 orders included KRW6.4tn of high-value ships.
counter_evidence: A large one-time offshore revenue recognition, FX exposure, defense-bid costs and shipbuilding cyclicality reduce normalized-earnings confidence.

evidence: Q2 2026 revenue rose 13.3% to KRW1.6tn with operating profit KRW232.4bn.
Defense export and rail franchises provide multi-year backlog optionality.
counter_evidence: Q2 operating profit declined YoY; program timing, working capital and defense-contract concentration remain meaningful.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW1.3937tn +45% and operating profit KRW451.8bn +86.3%, operating margin 32.4%.
High-margin new products grew 76% and reached 65% of biologics revenue; U.S./Europe portfolio broadening continues.
counter_evidence: Biosimilar pricing, pipeline/regulatory execution and KRW1.2tn DS-capacity expansion create reinvestment-return risk.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW1.11tn +17.4% and operating profit KRW105.7bn +29.5%.
Backlog KRW24.57tn with guided-weapons, ISR and electronic-warfare growth.
counter_evidence: Financing costs increased; defense-customer/geopolitical concentration and working-capital needs are substantial.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW794.9bn +27.5% and operating profit KRW73.7bn +21.2%, both record highs.
U.S. unit posted first quarterly operating profit; China +33% and Korea +23%, supported by global K-beauty customer expansion.
counter_evidence: ODM customer churn, beauty-cycle volatility and relatively thin consolidated margins limit moat certainty.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW1.2902tn +94.9% and operating profit KRW410.9bn +67%; H1 operating profit KRW972.5bn.
PUBG franchise revenue +25% and Subnautica 2 reached 5m units rapidly, improving IP diversification.
counter_evidence: PUBG remains economically dominant; game-hit cyclicality and development/acquisition capital allocation require monitoring.

evidence: H1 revenue KRW1.82tn +15.5% and operating profit KRW298.0bn +17.9%.
China, Vietnam and Russia continue double-digit growth; overseas capacity expansion is internally funded.
counter_evidence: Packaged food has low switching costs and raw-material/FX shocks can compress margins.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW1.68tn +10.6% and operating profit KRW264.3bn, up from KRW164.3bn.
Grid/transformer scarcity and U.S. power-infrastructure demand support pricing and backlog.
counter_evidence: Capital intensity, construction exposure and cycle normalization can compress current margins.

evidence: Sep.10 NAV per share KRW2,088,601 versus stock price KRW1,135,000, a 45.7% discount.
2026-2028 shareholder-return policy commits at least 30% of recurring dividend income plus part of investment gains via buybacks/cancellations or dividends.
counter_evidence: NAV is overwhelmingly concentrated in SK hynix, so holding-company diversification is limited; discount closure depends on capital allocation rather than customer economics.

evidence: Q3 FY26 revenue $6.76bn +13%, ARR $27.5bn and OCF $2.52bn; AI-first ARR grew >150%.
Adobe retains 1bn+ monthly active users and strong recurring creative/document franchises.
counter_evidence: Generative AI lowers creation barriers, freemium can pressure near-term monetization, and CEO succession adds execution uncertainty.

evidence: Q3 FY26 record revenue $9.12bn +25%, GAAP operating margin 33.7%, EPS +43%.
AI/advanced logic, memory and packaging process complexity supports broad equipment demand and EPIC Center customer co-development.
counter_evidence: WFE cyclicality, China/export restrictions and customer capex concentration remain material.

evidence: Q2 2026 revenue $11.536bn +50%, Data Center revenue +107% and represented 58% of revenue.
H1 OCF less capex was $4.124bn; cash plus short-term investments exceeded debt by about $9.9bn.
counter_evidence: Conditional OpenAI/Meta warrants could represent up to 320m shares if milestones vest; third-party foundry/Taiwan and AI customer concentration are material.

evidence: Q2 adjusted operating EPS $2.55 and FY2026 guidance raised to $11.50-$12.50.
920MW of additional long-term PPAs and regulatory progress on Crane support scarce 24/7 clean-power demand.
counter_evidence: Calpine integration, commodity/power-price exposure and capital intensity complicate normalized owner cash.

evidence: Q2 FY27 revenue $1.47bn +26%, ARR $5.84bn +25%, record net-new ARR $333m and FCF $377m.
Falcon Flex ARR from adopters exceeded $2.29bn and grew 101%.
counter_evidence: SBC remains economically material and the 2024 outage remains a durability/governance reference point; cybersecurity competition is intense.

evidence: Q2 orders $24.2bn +88% organically, revenue $11.1bn +22%, adjusted EBITDA margin 11.3%, FCF $5.1bn.
Backlog increased $13bn sequentially and gas-power reservation/backlog reached 116GW.
counter_evidence: Wind execution history, project warranty risk and current supercycle pricing may not be permanent.

evidence: FY2026 revenue $21.4bn +14%, operating income $5.9bn +20%, OCF $8.8bn +42%.
Global Business Solutions grew 16% and the integrated tax/accounting/SMB data platform supports cross-sell and switching costs.
counter_evidence: AI-native accounting/tax tools and Mailchimp/credit risks could pressure acquisition economics or pricing.

evidence: FY2026 OCF $4.14bn and FCF $3.77bn; capital returns $3.35bn.
Process-control intensity rises with leading-edge complexity, supporting durable metrology/inspection demand and high switching costs.
counter_evidence: Semiconductor capex cyclicality and export restrictions create concentration and policy risk.

evidence: June-quarter revenue $6.72bn, GAAP operating margin 37.4%; September-quarter guide $8.1bn and 39.5% margin.
Etch/deposition intensity and installed-base service revenue scale with AI-driven device complexity.
counter_evidence: China represented 26% of June-quarter revenue and memory/WFE cyclicality can reverse abruptly.

evidence: Q1 FY27 revenue $19.3bn +30%, IaaS $7.4bn +121%, RPO $664bn.
OCI demand and database/application lock-in create a credible AI-infrastructure growth vector.
counter_evidence: Q1 FCF was about -$5bn and Oracle issued $20bn of common equity to fund the buildout; restructuring and margin pressure remain material.

evidence: FY26 Q4 revenue $3.41bn +34%, NGS ARR $9.1bn +63%, RPO $21.2bn +34%.
FY2026 adjusted FCF margin was 38.4%, supporting platformization economics.
counter_evidence: CyberArk/Chronosphere acquisition effects complicate organic growth; GAAP Q4 net loss and SBC/acquisition accounting require owner-cash normalization.

evidence: Q2 2026 revenue $4.3bn +17%; Dupixent global sales +38%, EYLEA HD U.S. +52%, Libtayo +30%.
Internally generated antibody/platform R&D and multiple commercial franchises support reinvestment quality.
counter_evidence: EYLEA franchise competition/patent pressure and pipeline binary risk remain significant.

evidence: Q2 FY27 RPO about $9.0bn and NRR 126%; Q1 product revenue $1.334bn +34% with FY27 product-revenue guide $5.84bn +31%.
AI Data Cloud, cross-cloud governance and AI-agent connectivity expand the workload surface.
counter_evidence: SBC and GAAP losses remain material; hyperscaler/databricks competition and consumption-model volatility constrain certainty.

evidence: Global acceptance, issuer/acquirer integration and network security create exceptionally strong two-sided scale economics.
Digital-payment penetration and value-added services continue to expand the addressable profit pool.
counter_evidence: Regulation/interchange pressure and account-to-account/stablecoin rails can cap pricing or shift transaction economics.
